comment: Golden `/specstride` cases (T038, contracts/150-host-hermes/slash-command.md): one per row, plus the unknown verb, exit 127 and exit 4. `expected_argv` entries `$SHIM` and `$CONTROL` stand for the resolved shim and control-CLI paths. `stub_result` is what the forwarded command printed; `expected_reply` is what the handler relays.

cases.name: status relays the status line and attention items verbatim

stub_result.stdout:
run feat-150 running · step supervise
attention: gate contract-review needs you

cases.expected_reply:
run feat-150 running · step supervise
attention: gate contract-review needs you

cases.name: doctor forwards to the control CLI

stub_result.stdout:
ok host.cli-found — specstride 0.1.0 on PATH
warn host.permission-mode — default profile

cases.expected_reply:
ok host.cli-found — specstride 0.1.0 on PATH
warn host.permission-mode — default profile

cases.name: a typed stop is the consent and forwards
a typed stop --now forwards the flag
run replies with the skill invocation and forwards nothing
cases.expected_reply: type /specstride-run to start (invoking it is the consent)

cases.name: dry-run replies with the skill invocation in that mode
an unknown verb is refused with the verb list
cases.expected_reply: refused — verbs: run, dry-run, status, stop, stop --now, resume, doctor

cases.name: an empty invocation is refused with the verb list
cases.expected_reply: refused — verbs: run, dry-run, status, stop, stop --now, resume, doctor

cases.name: exit 127 maps to the install line

stub_result.stderr: specstride-hermes: no specstride CLI on PATH

cases.name: exit 4 relays the refusal line verbatim
whitespace in the typed verb is collapsed
